title: The client
about: `apps/cli` is `nemia` and `wf` as a person types them: a client of the api, which spawns the orchestrator's own CLI for every verb it has not moved.

terms.meaning: which way a command goes (`routeOf`, `apps/cli/src/route.ts`): `api`, for a moved read (`READ_VERBS`: `show`, `closeout`, `ls`, the inbox's read, `watch`) asked of the api over HTTP; `process`, for every other verb, a help and a read typed with `--local`, run on the orchestrator's own CLI in a process of its own (`apps/cli/src/local.ts`).
a read run in process, on the orchestrator's own CLI, rather than asked of the api: for a store no daemon serves. The client takes the word off before it spawns that CLI, which does not know it.

a read that finds no daemon serving its store starts one, as a ticking command does, and asks again (`apps/cli/src/daemon.ts`); where none comes up it is refused, naming `nemia <verb> … --local` and `nemia service install`. Which daemon serves a store is the `url` of its lease, read in `apps/cli/src/where.ts` alone.
